hypothesis: High-resolution feature concatenation may overfit while independently normalized specialist probabilities retain complementary evidence. Test fixed convex probability experts with no learned gate or extra fit.
predeclared_comparisons: Each raw view uses the identical donor weight as its upsampled control. Preserve every combination, including negative results.
metric_selection: All 12 fixed combinations use original development validation and independently stopped original patient CV. Passing candidates require improved CV and nondecreasing validation Macro-F1, then new repeated-patient confirmation before external testing.
source_predictions: Only development validation and original-training outer patient predictions. No external predictions or metrics loaded.
training_note: No new backbone or head fits; each mixture reuses two separately trained three-seed predictor ensembles. These are composite inference candidates, not new training runs.
